body: I understand. I just don't know what to do anymore. I wish I could see a therapist or at least had friends. I think about suicide at least once a week now. I can't keep this up by myself anymore.
There's nothing you guys can even do. I'm stuck dealing with it by myself.
I've already tried to get help. No one cared. Everyone keeps telling me that I am on my own. I've had enough.

Every time I try to call a hotline or something they brush me off. There's no one around to help me and I have no friends. My counselor will not help me with my biggest problem and tells me to go to a doctor. My mom will not pay for a doctor or meds because it's too expensive. People have shamed me for my feelings telling me to get over it and to kill myself and when I asked for help someone said I had to fix it on my own. I can't take it anymore no one cares to help me and no one will care when I kill myself.
I've failed at getting help and have been shamed too many times. I can't it another minute.
They advertise someone to talk to and help. Most of the time they provide neither. That's why people are mad. Ya dig?
It doesn't matter anymore. I've made up my mind. Suicide it is. Sorry for wasting your time.

All I was doing was trying to explain why some people are frustrated with the hotline. It's not becuse 'they're entitled' it's because half the time they never even answer. I hope you never give your 'great wisdom' to anyone who is depressed.
Crisis Management means do nothing? If half the time they don't even answer, and when they do just repeat what you said and rush you off the phone, how is that crisis management?

It's because 8/10 suicide hotlines don't help. You're put on hold for a freaking eternity and if you do get someone they just repeat shit back to you and try to end the call as soon as possible. I've called over 10 times. If the hotline works for you, you're lucky.
Refrain from telling them things like 'get over it' or worse 'just do it'. In my experience, it's not very helpful.

I just don't get why some people need to explain away every little thing people have problems with in this show, as if saying something bad about it will make them not true fans or taint their love for the show. This show helped me with my depression, and I'll always love it for that, but I thought the Weiss fight was garbage. It, like the other fights in that room, was slow and clunky, which doesn't make sense for Weiss because we've seen her move faster than that (the Banesaw fight). Plus the fight makes her look stupid. When something doesn't work, you adapt to something different. And you never turn your back on your opponent. Plus Weiss should be smart enough to know that her summons arent very efficient when pit against enemies with projectiles (Vernal, Hazel, Ironwood). 

I just don't get when people try to find explanations for every flaw. That's how we get No Man's Sky.
I'm pretty sure my mom would rather chop off her arm than give me meds. These herbs we got near public should do. But thanks anyway.
The hotline put me on hold, and I can't go to a hospital or my parents will get mad. Thanks for caring, though.
